title: Neuroepo multisession
description: Resting-state EEG recorded from 25 patients with Parkinson's disease in a double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled trial of Neuroepo, an EPO formulation with low sialic acid content. Recordings were acquired before and six months after drug administration, in Neuroepo (n=15) and placebo (n=10) groups. The raw data are shared in EEG-BIDS format to support evaluation of EEG biomarkers of neuroprotection, including qualitative expert ratings and quantitative source-level analysis.
methods_description: Resting-state EEG was recorded before and six months after administration of Neuroepo or placebo. Qualitative EEG abnormalities were rated by two experts on a Likert-type scale and analyzed with a multivariate item response theory approach. Quantitative EEG source analysis used VARETA with the MNI atlas. Group and pre/post comparisons used permutation tests and surfstat contrasts with Bonferroni correction.
